{"description":"Design: docs/design/blobext.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: B18. Crates: jmap-blob-types, jmap-blob-server. Size: S.

Per docs/design/DECISIONS.md decisions 1, 2, 17 and 19, docs/design/blobext.md §4 (SetObject note), §7 (ConditionalBackend bullet), §9 'conditional-02', and docs/design/conditional.md §5.1/§9 (draft-ietf-jmap-conditional-02):
- impl jmap_types::SetObject for BlobObject (SERVER_SET [id, size], CLIENT_SETTABLE [type, expires], IMMUTABLE [type]).
- Add the separate attach call register_blob_conditional<B: BlobBackend + ConditionalBackend>(dispatcher, backend), made after register_blob_handlers: it attaches SetSupport::new::<BlobObject, B> to the registered Blob/set through Dispatcher::attach_set_support (decision 17). register_blob_handlers is unchanged; Blob/set is not re-registered.
- Memory backend implements ConditionalBackend with the blob map on ScopedState, so atomic rollback discards created blobs, noPersist ones included. atomic runs in the dispatcher's begin_set scope; BlobBackend has no atomic hook of its own (decision 17).
- No evaluation code in set.rs.
- Pointers to type or expires (Blob/get never returns them) get invalidArguments under conditional §3.1 rule 4, not forbidden: the dispatcher's internal Blob/get rejects the unknown property name and the evaluator returns that error as is (decision 19). Do not mark them unreadable. size, digest:<alg>, {} and null work.
Needs the JMAP-y1yu pieces: ConditionalBackend and attach_set_support (C2), dispatcher evaluator (C3), ScopedState (C4).
